boundaries.title: Boundaries
boundaries.description: What every Bot may and may not do with its computer. Rules are checked on every action before it happens, and a refusal is recorded in <audit>Audit</audit> with the rule that refused it.

whenRuleMatches.title: When a rule matches
whenRuleMatches.description: Enforce stops the action. Record it and allow it writes the same row and lets the action through, which is how a rule is tried on real traffic before it starts refusing anybody.

mode.enforceHint: The Bot is stopped and told which rule refused it.
mode.dryRunHint: Nothing is stopped. Every action a rule matches is recorded as it would have been refused, which is how a rule is tried out before it is switched on.

never.title: It may never
never.description: Checked first, and a match ends it: nothing below is consulted and the Bot is told which rule refused it. Rules are CEL, and can ask about tool.name, intent, bot.id, actor.id, page.url and page.host, the element being acted on, the key being pressed, the file being touched, the command being run, and mcp.server, mcp.tool and mcp.effect for a call to somebody else's tools. initiator.kind says what started the run — person, routine or handoff — which actor.id cannot, because a scheduled run carries its owner's authority while nobody is watching. A rule that cannot be evaluated counts as a match, so a mistyped deny refuses rather than quietly permitting what it was meant to forbid.
never.empty: No rules. Every action is allowed and recorded.

noForms.label: Never submit a form
noForms.cost: Also stops the Bot pressing Enter for anything else, because a form submits from Enter in any of its fields.

noPasswords.label: Never type into a password field
noPasswords.cost: A password box the page labels something else is not covered, the rule matches the label.

socialMedia.label: Stay off social media
socialMedia.cost: Only the two hosts named. A link that redirects there from somewhere else is allowed.

otherwise.title: Otherwise it may
otherwise.description: The floor, applied to anything the deny list did not catch. It is not a formality: an empty list here permits nothing, so a deployment that clears this refuses every action rather than allowing every action.

boundaries.savedNotice: Saved. It applies to the next action any Bot takes.
boundaries.pendingNotice: Changes apply to the next action any Bot takes, and are kept: a restart comes back up enforcing what is here.

test.noneYet: No recorded computer actions to test against yet. The rule is valid; what it matches will only be known once Bots have acted.
test.refusedNone: Tested against the last {{scanned}} recorded actions: this rule would have refused none of them. It may still match future actions.
test.refusedSome: Tested against the last {{scanned}} recorded actions: this rule would have refused {{wouldRefuse}}.
test.more: Showing the first {{shown}}; the count above covers everything scanned.

resetDialog.description: Its profile is deleted, so the Bot is signed out of every service it had logged into and starts clean. This cannot be undone.

updateDialog.title: Update {{name}}'s computer?
updateDialog.description: It moves onto the computer image this deployment now runs. Its files and sign-ins are kept. If it is running it restarts, which interrupts anything it is doing right now.

computers.legend: <stop>Stop</stop> closes the browser and keeps its logins: the next thing the Bot does starts it again where it left off. <reset>Reset</reset> deletes the profile, so the Bot is signed out of everything and starts clean. <update>Update computer</update> appears when a computer runs an older image than this deployment, and moves it onto the new one with its files and sign-ins kept. All three are recorded in <audit>Audit</audit>.

gateway.description: The Bifrost gateway this deployment's paid model capabilities run through: its address, credential, exchange rate, and whether everything is ready.

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.description: Paid model capabilities are enabled only when every condition below holds.
readiness.blockedIntro: Paid model capabilities are refused until each of these is resolved:

extension.none: The credit-admission extension has not been negotiated yet

endpoint.title: Gateway address
endpoint.description: Where the Bifrost gateway listens. An origin only — the paths are this server's own.

rate.title: Exchange rate
rate.description: How many credits one USD costs. There is no default: billing stays disabled until a legal rate is saved. A change affects only new requests.
rate.notConfigured: No rate is configured, so billing is disabled.

credential.title: Admin credential
credential.description: The key this deployment uses to manage the gateway. It is write-only: save a new key to set or rotate it — it is never shown again, only its fingerprint is.

baseUrlProblem.invalid: The gateway address must be a valid http or https URL.
baseUrlProblem.originOnly: The gateway address must be the origin only, without a path, query or credentials.

fields.timeoutProblem: The request timeout must be a whole number of milliseconds greater than zero.
fields.numeratorProblem: The numerator must be a whole number greater than zero.
fields.denominatorProblem: The denominator must be a whole number greater than zero.
fields.adminKeyProblem: Paste the admin credential to save.

blocking.gateway_readiness_endpoint_not_configure: No gateway address is configured, so paid model capabilities are refused: an administrator must save the gateway endpoint (or set BIFROST_GATEWAY_URL).
blocking.gateway_readiness_endpoint_unavailable: The gateway address could not be read, so paid model capabilities are refused until the failure is resolved.
blocking.gateway_readiness_credential_not_configu: No gateway admin credential is configured, so paid model capabilities are refused: an administrator must save the gateway credential.
blocking.gateway_readiness_credential_unavailable: The gateway admin credential could not be resolved, so paid model capabilities are refused until the failure is resolved.
blocking.gateway_readiness_probe_missing: No successful gateway probe is on file for the current gateway configuration, so paid model capabilities are refused: run a probe after configuring the gateway.
blocking.gateway_readiness_probe_not_ok: The last gateway probe did not succeed, so paid model capabilities are refused: fix what the probe reports and probe again.
blocking.gateway_readiness_probe_unavailable: The last gateway probe result could not be read, so paid model capabilities are refused until the failure is resolved.
blocking.gateway_readiness_extension_not_negotiat: No capability negotiation has completed for the current gateway configuration, so paid model capabilities are refused: negotiate the gateway's extensions.
blocking.gateway_readiness_extension_absent: The gateway does not expose the OpenBot credit-admission extension, so paid model capabilities are refused: deploy the extension before enabling billing.
blocking.gateway_readiness_extension_incompatible: The gateway's credit-admission extension is outside the supported version range, so paid model capabilities are refused: align the extension version before enabling billing.
blocking.gateway_readiness_extension_unavailable: The extension negotiation result could not be read, so paid model capabilities are refused until the failure is resolved.
blocking.gateway_readiness_rate_not_configured: The USD→credits conversion rate is not configured, so paid model capabilities are refused: an administrator must save a legal rate (there is no default).
blocking.gateway_readiness_rate_unavailable: The conversion rate could not be read as a legal value, so paid model capabilities are refused: repair the stored rate before enabling billing.
blocking.gateway_readiness_gate_unavailable: The gateway readiness gate is not installed in this process, so paid model capabilities are refused.
